environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an internal Application Load Balancer (scheme: internal) in private subnets (10.40.8.0/22, 10.40.12.0/22). The ALB security group sg-0b7c3d9f has inbound rules restricted to three source security groups: sg-frontend-bff (10.40.0.0/24 BFF tier), sg-cron-workers (10.40.4.0/24 batch tier), and sg-internal-tooling (10.40.16.0/28 admin VPN endpoint). There is no NAT gateway or internet gateway route in the subnet route tables for inbound traffic. Additionally, a VPC endpoint policy on the execute-api endpoint restricts invocations to principals within the same AWS Organization (condition: aws:PrincipalOrgID). The NLB in front performs TLS termination with mutual TLS (mTLS) requiring client certificates issued by ACM PCA ca-0f8a2b3c4d5e6f7a8, which are only provisioned to the three authorized service identities via IAM Roles Anywhere trust anchors.

config.subnet_route_tables: no IGW route, no NAT for inbound
config.vpc_endpoint_policy: aws:PrincipalOrgID condition restricts to org o-abc123def4
